streak.note: No bg copy exists at c8a49dd (0 of 1189 keys), so this is a seed, not a catalog majority. Apple's own Bulgarian word for a run of days: '{{goal_value}}-дневна серия за Движение' (iOS 26.1 (23B86): System/Library/Health/Assets/FitnessUIAssets.bundle/ActivityAchievements/MonthlyAchievements/localization/challenge/MoveStreak_SMALL_INCREASE | Localizable-Modified-tinker.stringsdict | ACHIEVEMENT_UNACHIEVED_ALERT_DESCRIPTION_NAME/NSStringLocalizedFormatKey). Governs the 46-key en streak family (widgets.streak.*, share.card.streak*, streakFreeze.*, paywall.benefit.streak.*, insights.summary.dayStreakTitle). The forms list cannot cover the compounds UI copy will produce ('серия от %lld дни', 'ДНИ В СЕРИЯ', 'дневна серия'); the bare forms match inside them because matching is whole-word, but a hyphenated coinage like 'X-дневна' will not be counted.

streak_freeze.note: Seed: Apple's Bulgarian for a freeze is 'замразяване' (iOS 26.1 (23B86): System/Library/ExtensionKit/Extensions/CameraSettingsAppIntentsExtension.appex | Localizable.strings | freeze). Governs 12 en keys (streakFreeze.*, widgets.streak.copy.frozen.*, widgets.streak.a11y.frozen, paywall.benefit.streak.detail). The bare 'замразяване' forms are listed so a genitive the list cannot spell ('замразяване на серията', 'едно замразяване') still counts; the forbidden entries are transliterations, and none collides with an everyday Bulgarian word. One earned freeze covers one day, never two (comment on paywall.benefit.streak.detail).

task.note: Seed: Apple's Bulgarian for Task is 'Задача' / 'Задачи' (iOS 26.1 (23B86): System/Library/Frameworks/ClassKit.framework | ClassKit.strings | CONTEXT_TYPE_TASK; System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/DataAccess.framework | DataAccess.strings | AUTOGENERATED_MAIN_TASKS_TITLE). Governs focusTask.*, plan.*, widgets.tasks.*, insights.mood.completedTasks. 'активност' is NOT in forbidden on purpose: Apple's Screen Time strings legitimately say 'данните за активността ви' (FamilyControlsAuthenticationUI.app | Localizable.strings | NOTIFICATION_AUTH_REQUEST_MESSAGE_INDIVIDUAL) and the app's own onboarding.screenTimePermission.* keys mean activity data, so banning it would flag correct copy. Judge 'активност' for a task by hand instead.

restricted_list.note: Seed, chosen for plain wording: 'блокирани' says what happens during a session, and app blocking is already the welcome eyebrow (onboarding.welcome.slide.block.eyebrow, en 'App blocking'). Governs screenTime.createRestrictedList.*, screenTime.restrictedAppsPicker.*, plan.createToDo.removeRestrictedApps, plan.createToDo.restrictedAppsSection, AND screenTime.restrictedApps.appsRestricted — resolved 2026-09-16: the en source itself splits 'restricted' (screenTime.restrictedApps.*, screenTime.createRestrictedList.*) from 'blocked' (plan.createToDo.removeRestrictedApps, onboarding.welcome.slide.block.eyebrow) for the same set of apps, and this glossary picks one Bulgarian adjective for both sides rather than carrying the en split into bg (Decided conflicts). screenTime.restrictedApps.appsRestricted therefore takes '%lld блокирано приложение' / '%lld блокирани приложения', not 'ограничено/ограничени' — the count-form rule in the brief governs only the singular/plural agreement, not the word choice. The forms list carries the definite variants Bulgarian actually produces but cannot cover count-form summary fragments like this one; check those by hand. The group name itself ships as the unlocalized Swift literal 'No Restricted Apps' (Manifesting/Features/Plan/Data/Repositories/ToDoTaskRepository.swift:333): flag it, never translate it in place.

time_value.note: Seed: Apple's Bulgarian for Value is 'Стойност' (iOS 26.1 (23B86): System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/ActionKit.framework | Localizable.strings | Value (Content Property Name)). Governs insights.savings.*, achievements.category.wages.*, widgets.cash.*, widgets.monthlyTimeValue.*, widgets.focusRing.a11y.money, onboarding.with*Moneyfesting.*. The bare 'стойност' is deliberately not a form: it would count every unrelated use. 'доход' (singular) and 'приходи' are deliberately NOT forbidden here because the fixed disclaimers 'Това не е източник на доход.' and 'Стойност на времето, не приходи.' need them; the banned-word table in the brief carries those stems with that exception stated. Caveat: term_audit.py matches these two forms as fixed, contiguous, word-bounded phrases with no gap tolerance, but most real keys this term governs (widgets.cash.description, widgets.monthlyTimeValue.description, insights.savings.estimateExplanation/measuredEstimateExplanation/focusHistoryEstimateExplanation, achievements.category.wages.description) phrase it as 'value of [adjective(s)] time' with a possessive or adjective inserted between 'на' and 'времето' (e.g. 'стойността на твоето фокусирано време'), which will not match either fixed form. term_audit's count for this term cannot be trusted as coverage evidence; check it by hand every batch instead.

time_value_disclaimer.note: Seed: one target form per source form, reused verbatim on all 11 en keys that carry 'Not money earned.' (achievements.badge.*.earned ×7, achievements.category.wages.description, widgets.cash.description, widgets.focusRing.a11y.money, widgets.monthlyTimeValue.description). hourly_rate.note: Seed: the en source says 'hourly rate' and 'hourly wage' for one thing the user sets; 'ставка' is the neutral Bulgarian word and avoids the salary reading the concept forbids. Governs onboarding.hourlyWage.*, profile.hourlyWage.*, currency.settings.*, screenTimeReport.missingWage, achievements.category.wages.description. Forbidden lists only multiword phrases on purpose: the bare 'заплата' must stay legal because the badge name for en 'Salaried' is the metaphor 'На заплата' (achievements.badge.salaried.name), and banning the word would flag it.

goal.note: Seed: Apple's Bulgarian for Goal is 'Цел', plural 'Цели' (iOS 26.1 (23B86): Applications/Fitness.app | Localizable.strings | Goal; System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/WorkoutUI.framework | Localizable.strings | GOALS_AX_TITLE). minute_unit.note: Seed from Foundation output, not from a catalog: bg_BG abbreviated durations print '25 мин' and '1 ч и 45 мин' (iOS 26.1 runtime ICU 76.1.0.0, facts/per-locale/bg/locale-formats.json durations). Spaced '%lld мин' is the default everywhere; the tight '%lldмин' is allowed only on width-limited widget and report lines (widgets.streak.focusedInStreak, widgets.streak.focusedMinutesSummary, screenTimeReport.durationMinutesOnly, moneyfesting.details.timeElapsedFormat) and only with render evidence, because Apple never prints it tight. Exception: share.duration.minutesShort keeps the single-letter '%lldм' mirroring the en share card. forbidden is empty because a bare 'м' is also the metre abbreviation; a bare 'м' outside the share card is still a finding, judged by hand.

screen_time.note: Apple's Bulgarian name for the feature (iOS 26.1 (23B86): Applications/Preferences.app | Localizable.strings | Screen Time; System/Library/PrivateFrameworks/ScreenTimeSettingsUI.framework | Localizable.strings | ScreenTimeControllerTitle). open.recommended_reason: The app's controls, celebrations and widget lines are short second-person lines where the polite plural reads institutional, and Apple's own Bulgarian buttons are already 2sg imperatives.
open.note: Affects every reader-directed string: the 177 second-person possessive en units, the 12 control labels, all onboarding and celebration copy. Evidence 2026-09-16, iOS 26.1 (23B86): Apple body text is 2pl with lowercase clitics (FamilyControlsAuthenticationUI.app | Localizable.strings | NOTIFICATION_AUTH_REQUEST_MESSAGE_INDIVIDUAL 'данните за активността ви'; HealthUI.framework | HealthUI-Localizable.strings | AUTHORIZATION_DONT_ALLOW_ALERT_MESSAGE 'можете'), Apple buttons are 2sg imperatives (UserNotificationsServer.framework | Localizable.strings | PERMISSION_ALERT_ALLOW 'Позволи', PERMISSION_ALERT_DENY 'Не позволявай'; UIKitCore.framework | Localizable.strings | Save 'Запази'), and Apple motivational copy is 2pl imperative (FitnessUIAssets.bundle/ActivityAchievements/365AllGoals/localization | Localizable-Modified-tinker.stringsdict | ACHIEVEMENT_UNACHIEVED_PROGRESS_THREE_AWAY_DESC 'Затворете вашите кръгове'). Cost of each option: 'Вие' makes every reader-directed l-participle gender-neutral, because the plural participle has one common form; 'ти' forces a gender choice on each one, which the brief's Address and gender section works around with the aorist, imperatives, nominal sentences and object agreement. App CLAUDE.md names no bg register (line 43 covers ro only), and no fetched source establishes a Bulgarian consumer-app norm. Meanwhile: translate with 'ти', keep every iOS mirror in Apple's plural, and list in the report every key where 'ти' forced a gendered form so a flip has its list ready. Polite forms stay lowercase in either option (Decided conflicts).

open.recommended_reason: en already shares the word 'Focus' with the iOS system mode and accepted the overlap, and the longer alternative costs width on exactly the widget surfaces that have none to spare.
open.note: Affects widgets.startFocus.heading (en 'Focus session'), widgets.startFocus.*, profile.sessionDetails.*, moneyfesting.details.*, onboarding.welcome.preview.blocking.*, profile.home.focusSection (en 'Focus'), widgets.focusRing.*. Evidence 2026-09-16, iOS 26.1 (23B86): Apple names the system Focus mode 'Фокус' (Applications/Preferences.app | Localizable.strings | Focus; System/Library/ControlCenter/Bundles/FocusUIModule.bundle | Localizable.strings | MODULE_DEFAULT_TITLE) and Do Not Disturb 'Не безпокойте' (DoNotDisturb.framework | Localizable.strings | MODE_NAME_DEFAULT, value carries U+00AD soft hyphens); Apple's word for Session is 'Сесия' (SensorKitUI.framework/AuthGroups/ECG.bundle | InfoPlist.strings | Session). 'концентрация' is 12 characters against 5 for 'фокус' and would push widgets.startFocus.heading past the Start Focus capsule budget (about 118pt of text, references/surface-budgets.md). No key names the system mode and the app ships no Focus filter, so nothing shows the two confused. Meanwhile: use 'фокус' and 'фокусирам се' for the app concept, never for the system mode, and let the adjudicator list every key that touched the term.

open.recommended_reason: VoiceOver reads the forecast line and the month-end figure one after the other, so they need two different words, and 'Прогноза' leaves the estimate family free for the figure.
open.note: Affects insights.savings.forecast (en 'Forecast') beside insights.savings.monthEnd, plus insights.savings.estimateExplanation, measuredEstimateExplanation, focusHistoryEstimateExplanation and insights.appUsage.permissionDescription. 28 en keys already use the 'estimate' family, which the Money frame spends on the disclaimers ('Приблизителна стойност на времето, не спечелени пари.'), so reusing 'Оценка' on both lines would make the card say the same word twice within one VoiceOver pass. 'Проекция' is a calque that reads technical. Meanwhile: 'Прогноза' on the forecast line, 'Оценка към края на месеца' on the month-end figure, and never the same word on both.

open.recommended_reason: The how-to screen walks the reader through menus that say 'инструмент', and a tutorial that names the thing differently from the menu it points at fails at its one job.
open.note: Affects app-owned widget copy only: onboarding.widgets.howTo.chooseTitle, editTitle, subtitle, step4, onboarding.widgets.intro.appIconInstruction, onboarding.welcome.preview.streak.homeScreen, onboarding.welcome.slide.streak.eyebrow, profile.home.widgetsRow and the widget gallery display names. The mirrors are out of scope: they must equal Apple's value. Evidence 2026-09-16, iOS 26.1 (23B86): Apple translates the noun everywhere in Bulgarian (SpringBoardHome.framework | SpringBoardHome.strings | WIDGET 'Инструмент', EDIT_MENU_ADD_WIDGET 'Добави инструмент', REMOVE_WIDGET_SHORTCUT_ITEM_TITLE 'Премахни инструмент', WIDGET_ADD_SHEET_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER 'Търси инструменти', REMOVE_WIDGET_BODY_REMOVE_DATA 'Премахването на този инструмент няма да изтрие приложения или данни.'; SmartStackSettingsUI.framework | Localizable.strings | SMART_STACK_SUGGESTION_SETTINGS_WIDGETS_SECTION_HEADER 'Инструменти'), against ro, which keeps 'widget'. The cost of 'инструмент' is that it also means 'tool' in general. Meanwhile: use 'инструмент' everywhere, mirrors included, and record any string where it reads as a generic tool rather than the feature.

open.recommended_reason: The label resolves against the device language precisely so it reads like the user's own Home Screen, and a word the device never shows sends the reader looking for a button that is not there.
open.note: Affects onboarding.widgets.howTo.editPillLabel, drawn on the illustrated iOS Edit pill (Manifesting/Features/Onboarding/Business/WidgetsHowTo/View/HomeScreenJiggleIllustrationView.swift:151), and step2, which quotes it. Evidence 2026-09-16, iOS 26.1 (23B86): SpringBoardHome.framework | SpringBoardHome.strings | EDIT is the literal '+' in bg, the same choice Apple makes in fi, hu, tr and fr, while ro reads 'Editați' and de the abbreviation 'Bearb.'; UIKitCore.framework | Localizable.strings | Edit is the generic 'Редакция', a single-string outlier against the ~30 other iOS 26.1 Edit/EDIT keys that render 'Редактирай' (controls.Edit), and either way a word no Bulgarian Home Screen displays. A yes needs a render check of the drawn pill and of step2 ('Натисни + в горния ъгъл, после Добави инструмент.'), where a bare '+' mid-sentence may need quoting as „+“. No test pins the value. Meanwhile: mirror '+' and raise the render question in the batch report.
